class.name: NetwPromise
class.brief_description: The result of a network request, available once it arrives.
class.description: A promise settles once. [method then] runs with the returned value, or [method catch_error] runs with an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. Chaining after it settled runs the callback immediately. [codeblock] Netw.request(server.buy_item, item_id) \ .then(func(receipt: Dictionary) -> void: show_receipt(receipt)) \ .catch_error(func(code: Error, detail: String) -> void: show_error(error_string(code) if detail.is_empty() else detail) ) [/codeblock] Or [code]await[/code] it with [method wait]. [codeblock] var receipt = await Netw.request(server.buy_item, item_id).wait() [/codeblock] [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_TIMEOUT no reply in time ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the other peer disconnected ┖╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED the other peer refused [/codeblock] A returned [Node] arrives as this peer's own copy. See [NetwGroupPromise] for requests to many peers.

method.name: answer
method.description: Returns [member result] on success, or [member code] on failure.

method.name: catch_error
method.description: Calls [param cb] as [code]cb(code, detail)[/code] when the promise fails. Returns the promise.

method.name: reject
method.description: Fails the promise with [param err_code] and emits [signal failed], then [signal settled]. Does nothing when already settled. Pushes a warning when nothing handles the failure.

method.name: rejected
method.description: Returns a promise that already failed with [param code].

method.name: resolve
method.description: Completes the promise with [param val] and emits [signal completed], then [signal settled]. Does nothing when already settled.

method.name: resolved
method.description: Returns a promise that already completed with [param value].

method.name: then
method.description: Calls [param cb] with [member result] when the promise completes. Returns the promise.

method.name: wait
method.description: Returns a signal to [code]await[/code], which gives [method answer]. It works even when the promise already settled, which awaiting [signal settled] does not. [codeblock] var err: Error = await engine.flush(keys).wait() [/codeblock]

method.name: when_settled
method.description: Calls [param cb] with no arguments when the promise settles, whether it completed or failed. Returns the promise. [codeblock] operation.when_settled(func() -> void: reply(operation.code)) [/codeblock]

members.member: A readable reason for [member code], or empty. For display only.
[code]true[/code] when the promise completed or failed.

signal.name: ready
signal.description: Used by [method wait]. Connect to [signal settled] instead, since this can be emitted more than once.

signal.name: settled
signal.description: Emitted once when the promise completes or fails. Do not [code]await[/code] it, since it may already have fired. Use [method wait].
